_doc: Central bank speeches read from the banks' OWN sites, for tone the desk may trade on. Adding a bank is adding a row. `terms` is the reuse clause as read on `terms_read`; `terms` is 'permitted' only where a clause on the bank's own page allowing reuse was read; any other value is carried on every row so a consumer can drop it. The BIS speeches.zip corpus is NOT here: its page says 'Use of the content is allowed for noncommercial purposes', so it stays research-only (side_channels/bis_speech_tone.py).
user_agent: quant-desk-research/1.0 (public central bank speeches; polite, low rate)
